notes: Measured model: F = L / tan(FOV/2), L = half layer width (FOV Orientation 1; 2 Vertical = half height and 3 Diagonal = half diagonal are inferred, not measured). Output pixel centre at radius r from Center samples the layer at s = r / sqrt(1 - (r/F)^2) (normal; r >= F transparent) or s = r / sqrt(1 + (r/F)^2) (Reverse Lens Distortion, exact inverse), bilinear on premultiplied pixels with centres at +0.5, transparent outside the layer. F was confirmed by a radial ray fit (554.15 vs 554.26 predicted) and a full-image scan. Reverse: exact (max 1). Normal: exact wherever the map minifies by less than ~1.2x; at the content edges far from Center (radial minification ~1.5x) AE filters differently (its edge ramps are ~1.4 source px wide, like an area filter, but area/box, mip and supersampled filters were all worse overall), giving up to 44 levels on 0.2 % of the pixels. Not reproduced: AE 5 Optimal Pixels, AE 6 Resize Layer (popup Off|Max 2X|Max 4X|Unlimited; the canvas is the layer). Reference length uses the canvas size: keep fxPad = 0.
